@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@{{{effect radius}}}@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@@@casttime@@none@@cost@@40@@cooldown@@12 / 11 / 10 / 9 / 8@@targeting@@Unit@@damagetype@@@@spellshield@@@@projectile@@{{{projectile}}}@@notes@@ * ''Stand Behind Me'' can be used on allied [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] but not on [[File:Ward_icon.png|20px|link=Ward|An icon representing the keyword Ward]] [[:Ward|wards]] nor [[File:Noxious Trap.png|20px|link=Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|An icon representing the keyword Stealthed trap]] [[:Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|traps]]. * ''Stand Behind Me'' has a [[File:Targeting forgiveness.svg|20px|link=Targeting#Targeting_Forgiveness|An icon representing the keyword Targeting forgiveness]] [[:Targeting#Targeting_Forgiveness|forgiveness radius]] of 175 units. * If there are no nearby enemy champions, '''Braum''' will dash to land up-to 150 units on the far side of his target. * The maximum dash range without enemy champions present is ~650. An enemy champion on the far side of the ally will allow '''Braum''' to dash a total of up-to 800 units. * If [[File:Braum Unbreakable.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Unbreakable|An icon for Braum's ability Unbreakable]] [[Braum#Unbreakable|Unbreakable]] is cast during the dash, [[File:Braum Winter's Bite.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Winter's Bite|An icon for Braum's ability Winter's Bite]] [[Braum#Winter's Bite|Winter's Bite]] and [[File:Braum Glacial Fissure.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Glacial Fissure|An icon for Braum's ability Glacial Fissure]] [[Braum#Glacial Fissure|Glacial Fissure]] may also be cast. * If the [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] is interrupted, neither '''Braum''' nor his ally receive the bonus resistances.@@
